briefing.headline: LGHL rockets 47.8% as the biggest overnight mover
briefing.summary: Mega‑cap tech names were mostly flat to slightly lower, with the core index SPY down only 0.03% and the QQQ slipping 0.16%. The breadth was thin, only two advancers versus eight decliners among the major US stocks. In contrast, several small‑cap tokens surged dramatically – LGHL up nearly 48%, CAPR up 23.7% and FOIL up 12.7% – while a few like MAAS and CNXC fell double‑digits. Overall the tape showed modest risk‑off pressure on the large caps but strong speculative upside in niche plays.
